actual_request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete original production sprite of 10_crimson_spear_girl, a grounded short-step walking pose, native square at least 1024x1024, genuinely transparent RGBA. No sheet, text, ground, shadow, checkerboard or background. Image 1 is authoritative identity: exact brown double buns AND two long twin tails with red ribbons, gold/turquoise ornaments, amber eyes, jeweled forehead charm, original red/ivory/gold embroidered layered dress, white sleeves and skirt frills, gold waist beads, red/gold boots. Image 2 is the confirmed main STYLE reference, clean bright rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted detail, restrained warm shading, delicate polished edges; do not copy its UI or other people. Image 3 fixes production body/head size, short chibi proportions, outfit, spear and stable two-hand grip. Preserve identity and these proportions; natural three-dimensional turning, never a mirror. Same long dark-shaft crimson crystal and gold spear with red tassels; anatomical LEFT hand high at chest, RIGHT hand low at waist, both physically on ONE straight shaft. Entire spear including butt, head, twin tails, ribbons, sleeves and both boots inside canvas, with margin. Fixed slightly elevated game camera. At 1024 scale: body center x512, virtual ground root [512,942], body/buns-to-boots about700px; full weapon bounds x65..960,y45..952. Maintain compact, balanced small stride, no running/jump/attack/high knee/crossed legs. Anatomical left/right always means HER left/right. Every frame has at least one grounded supporting foot. Torso almost vertical; subtle hair/sleeve inertia only. Highest available finish, no colored matte or purple fringe. DIRECTION WEST: pure LEFT-FACING side profile, nose and toes point screen-left, no frontal three-quarter face. HER anatomical LEFT leg and arm are NEAR viewer, RIGHT leg and arm are FAR. Near LEFT upper arm comes from near shoulder and its LEFT hand is the HIGH grip at chest. FAR RIGHT hand is the LOW grip at waist; do NOT swap the hands. FRAME W01 of a16-frame walk at30ms: Initial LEFT heel/sole contact ahead; LEFT leg leads, RIGHT leg behind with toe still touching ground and heel raised. Short double support. Near LEFT boot must be distinctly further screen-left than far RIGHT boot for W. Critical pose geometry for this pure-left-profile view: the NEAR sleeve/arm is bent UP; its hand is visibly the UPPER fist beside the near cheek/chest, connected to near shoulder by an elbow below it. The FAR arm goes DOWN toward waist, its LOWER fist partially hidden by torso/shaft. The spear slopes from its BUTT at lower-left to its BLADE at upper-right behind/above the head, never upper-left blade; this allows near hand high and far hand low. Blade, twin buns and all hair remain separated and uncropped. New drawing; no image from rejected W attempts is supplied. LEFT near boot forwards screen-left heel contact; RIGHT far boot trails screen-right toe contact.
